create_vector_store_file: create a vector store file by uploading it to a specified vector store via POST /v1/vector_stores/{vector_store_id}/files
list_vector_store_files: list all files associated with a vector store via GET /v1/vector_stores/{vector_store_id}/files
retrieve_vector_store_file: retrieve a specific vector store file by ID via GET /v1/vector_stores/{vector_store_id}/files/{file_id}
get_vector_store_file_content: get the raw content of a vector store file via GET /v1/vector_stores/{vector_store_id}/files/{file_id}/content
delete_vector_store_file: delete a vector store file from a vector store via DELETE /v1/vector_stores/{vector_store_id}/files/{file_id}
